401     def _validate_tool_input(self, tool_input: str) -> str:
402         try:
403             ast.literal_eval(tool_input)
404             return tool_input
405         except Exception:
406             # Clean and ensure the string is properly enclosed in braces
407             tool_input = tool_input.strip()
408             if not tool_input.startswith("{"):
409                 tool_input = "{" + tool_input
410             if not tool_input.endswith("}"):
411                 tool_input += "}"
412 
413             # Manually split the input into key-value pairs
414             entries = tool_input.strip("{} ").split(",")
415             formatted_entries = []
416 
417             for entry in entries:
418                 if ":" not in entry:
419                     continue  # Skip malformed entries
420                 key, value = entry.split(":", 1)
421 
422                 # Remove extraneous white spaces and quotes, replace single quotes
423                 key = key.strip().strip('"').replace("'", '"')
424                 value = value.strip()
425 
426                 # Handle replacement of single quotes at the start and end of the value string
427                 if value.startswith("'") and value.endswith("'"):
428                     value = value[1:-1]  # Remove single quotes
429                     value = (
430                         '"' + value.replace('"', '\\"') + '"'
431                     )  # Re-encapsulate with double quotes
432                 elif value.isdigit():  # Check if value is a digit, hence integer
433                     value = value
434                 elif value.lower() in [
435                     "true",
436                     "false",
437                     "null",
438                 ]:  # Check for boolean and null values
439                     value = value.lower()
440                 else:
441                     # Assume the value is a string and needs quotes
442                     value = '"' + value.replace('"', '\\"') + '"'
443 
444                 # Rebuild the entry with proper quoting
445                 formatted_entry = f'"{key}": {value}'
446                 formatted_entries.append(formatted_entry)
447 
448             # Reconstruct the JSON string
449             new_json_string = "{" + ", ".join(formatted_entries) + "}"
450             return new_json_string
451

78     def invoke(self, inputs: Dict[str, str]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
79         if "system" in self.prompt:
80             system_prompt = self._format_prompt(self.prompt.get("system", ""), inputs)
81             user_prompt = self._format_prompt(self.prompt.get("user", ""), inputs)
82 
83             self.messages.append(self._format_msg(system_prompt, role="system"))
84             self.messages.append(self._format_msg(user_prompt))
85         else:
86             user_prompt = self._format_prompt(self.prompt.get("prompt", ""), inputs)
87             self.messages.append(self._format_msg(user_prompt))

89         self._show_start_logs()
90 
91         self.ask_for_human_input = bool(inputs.get("ask_for_human_input", False))
92         formatted_answer = self._invoke_loop()
93 
94         if self.ask_for_human_input:
95             human_feedback = self._ask_human_input(formatted_answer.output)
96             if self.crew and self.crew._train:
97                 self._handle_crew_training_output(formatted_answer, human_feedback)
98 
99             # Making sure we only ask for it once, so disabling for the next thought loop
100             self.ask_for_human_input = False
101             self.messages.append(self._format_msg(f"Feedback: {human_feedback}"))
102             formatted_answer = self._invoke_loop()
103 
104             if self.crew and self.crew._train:
105                 self._handle_crew_training_output(formatted_answer)
106 
107         return {"output": formatted_answer.output}

109     def _invoke_loop(self, formatted_answer=None):

112                 if not self.request_within_rpm_limit or self.request_within_rpm_limit():
113                     answer = self.llm.call(
114                         self.messages,
115                         callbacks=self.callbacks,
116                     )
117 
118                     if not self.use_stop_words:
119                         try:
120                             self._format_answer(answer)
121                         except OutputParserException as e:
122                             if (
123                                 FINAL_ANSWER_AND_PARSABLE_ACTION_ERROR_MESSAGE
124                                 in e.error
125                             ):
126                                 answer = answer.split("Observation:")[0].strip()
127 
128                     self.iterations += 1
129                     formatted_answer = self._format_answer(answer)
130 
131                     if isinstance(formatted_answer, AgentAction):
132                         action_result = self._use_tool(formatted_answer)
133                         formatted_answer.text += f"\nObservation: {action_result}"
134                         formatted_answer.result = action_result
135                         self._show_logs(formatted_answer)
136 
137                         if self.step_callback:
138                             self.step_callback(formatted_answer)
139 
140                         if self._should_force_answer():
141                             if self.have_forced_answer:
142                                 return AgentFinish(
143                                     output=self._i18n.errors(
144                                         "force_final_answer_error"
145                                     ).format(formatted_answer.text),
146                                     text=formatted_answer.text,
147                                 )
148                             else:
149                                 formatted_answer.text += (
150                                     f'\n{self._i18n.errors("force_final_answer")}'
151                                 )
152                                 self.have_forced_answer = True
153                         self.messages.append(
154                             self._format_msg(formatted_answer.text, role="assistant")
155                         )
156 
157         except OutputParserException as e:
158             self.messages.append({"role": "user", "content": e.error})
159             if self.iterations > self.log_error_after:
160                 self._printer.print(
161                     content=f"Error parsing LLM output, agent will retry: {e.error}",
162                     color="red",
163                 )
164             return self._invoke_loop(formatted_answer)
165 
166         except Exception as e:
167             if LLMContextLengthExceededException(str(e))._is_context_limit_error(
168                 str(e)
169             ):
170                 self._handle_context_length()
171                 return self._invoke_loop(formatted_answer)
172             else:
173                 raise e
174 
175         self._show_logs(formatted_answer)
176         return formatted_answer
177

226     def _use_tool(self, agent_action: AgentAction) -> Any:
227         tool_usage = ToolUsage(
228             tools_handler=self.tools_handler,
229             tools=self.tools,
230             original_tools=self.original_tools,
231             tools_description=self.tools_description,
232             tools_names=self.tools_names,
233             function_calling_llm=self.function_calling_llm,
234             task=self.task,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
235             agent=self.agent,
236             action=agent_action,
237         )
238         tool_calling = tool_usage.parse(agent_action.text)
239 
240         if isinstance(tool_calling, ToolUsageErrorException):
241             tool_result = tool_calling.message
242         else:
243             if tool_calling.tool_name.casefold().strip() in [
244                 name.casefold().strip() for name in self.name_to_tool_map
245             ] or tool_calling.tool_name.casefold().replace("_", " ") in [
246                 name.casefold().strip() for name in self.name_to_tool_map
247             ]:
248                 tool_result = tool_usage.use(tool_calling, agent_action.text)
249             else:
250                 tool_result = self._i18n.errors("wrong_tool_name").format(
251                     tool=tool_calling.tool_name,
252                     tools=", ".join([tool.name.casefold() for tool in self.tools]),
253                 )
254         return tool_result
255 
256     def _summarize_messages(self) -> None:
257         messages_groups = []
258         for message in self.messages:
259             content = message["content"]
260             cut_size = self.llm.get_context_window_size()
261             for i in range(0, len(content), cut_size):
262                 messages_groups.append(content[i : i + cut_size])
263 
264         summarized_contents = []
265         for group in messages_groups:
266             summary = self.llm.call(
267                 [
268                     self._format_msg(
269                         self._i18n.slice("summarizer_system_message"), role="system"
270                     ),
271                     self._format_msg(
272                         self._i18n.slice("sumamrize_instruction").format(group=group),
273                     ),
274                 ],
275                 callbacks=self.callbacks,
276             )
277             summarized_contents.append(summary)
278 
279         merged_summary = " ".join(str(content) for content in summarized_contents)
280 
281         self.messages = [
282             self._format_msg(
283                 self._i18n.slice("summary").format(merged_summary=merged_summary)
284             )
285         ]
286 
287     def _handle_context_length(self) -> None:
288         if self.respect_context_window:
289             self._logger.log(
290                 "debug",
291                 "Context length exceeded. Summarizing content to fit the model context window.",
292                 color="yellow",
293             )
294             self._summarize_messages()
295         else:
296             self._logger.log(
297                 "debug",
298                 "Context length exceeded. Consider using smaller text or RAG tools from crewai_tools.",
299                 color="red",
300             )
301             raise SystemExit(
302                 "Context length exceeded and user opted not to summarize. Consider using smaller text or RAG tools from crewai_tools."
303             )
